body:

When the King stepped and was sealed inside, and the machine was powered on, &e00000he felt more alive than he had ever felt. Then, a pipe broke, strange particles filled the atmosphere,

and the King, sealed inside the machine, unable to do anything, watched as everyone he had ever known ablated &&&e0and sloughed into piles of viscera.

Every night, the King suffers through the same nightmare of the end of the world. 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000
